WHY IT MATTERS

Turn the feature into a better business process

A strong invoice answers five questions immediately: who is billing, who is paying, what was supplied, how the total was calculated, and when payment is due.

01

Fewer client questions

Clear descriptions, dates, quantities, rates, taxes, and totals make an invoice easier to approve.

02

A consistent business image

Using the same identity, numbering style, and layout helps customers recognize every document.

03

A better billing record

Keeping the final invoice with its status and payment entries creates a useful history for follow-up.

PRACTICAL CHECKLIST

Use professional invoices well

  • Use a unique, sequential invoice number.
  • Show an exact due date as well as the payment term.
  • Match descriptions and prices to the accepted estimate or agreement.
Always confirm the legal, tax, and record-keeping requirements that apply to your business.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about professional invoices

Can I add my business logo?

The invoice workflow supports branded business details and a company logo.

Can invoices include taxes and discounts?

Yes. Line items can be presented with applicable taxes, discounts, and calculated totals.

Can I record partial payments?

The existing marketing configuration describes recording full and partial payments and reviewing the remaining balance.

Can I create a PDF?

The current invoice workflow includes professional printable PDF generation.
